title: Heart Disease Prediction Using Deep Autoencoders and Synthetic Data Augmentation
summary: A deep learning project for heart disease classification that uses sparse and supervised denoising autoencoders to learn latent representations from structured medical data, combined with an ensemble model built on those latent features. To address limited training data, it fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic tabular data for augmentation.
